description: "Golden Turkey" fans, attention! It's a veritable voyage to the bottom of the sci-fi barrel as prehistoric "Slime People" emerge from the sewers of Los Angeles! The atom-age U.S. army is no match for this small band of spear-toting boogeymen and the city is evacuated.

title: The Sacrament
cast: Joe Swanberg, AJ Bowen, Ti West
description: Two journalists track a friend's estranged sister to the remote world of "Eden Parish," a rural utopia overseen by a mysterious leader known only as "Father." It quickly becomes evident to the newcomers that this paradise may not be as it seems.

title: The Rangers: Bloodstone
cast: David Nordquist, Dave Quirk, Dana Ventresca, Ken Nordquist, Dee Dattilo
description: An elite King's Ranger fueled by vengeance embarks on a journey to save his daughter and village from the forces of darkness.

title: The Dark Dance
cast: Franco Nero, Corinna Coroneo, Flavio Sciolé, Daphne Scoccia, Michela Bruni, Giorgia Trasselli
description: The clash between art and politics come to a head in this LGBTQ drama. It's populism against smaller artistic endeavors in this beautifully shot Italian film.

title: The Collingswood Story
cast: Stephanie Dees, John Burton, Diane Behrens, Grant Edmonds, Theodore
description: Years before Zoom and FaceTime the micro-budget film "The Collingswood Story" took the indie horror scene by storm. When Rebecca went away to college her boyfriend John thought webcams would help them stay in touch. But idle curiosity leads to a dark secret when they video chat with Vera Madeline, an online psychic, who initiates a deadly reign of terror over their lives.

title: Tarzan
cast: Kellan Lutz, Spencer Locke, Jaime Ray Newman
description: Tarzan must protect the jungle - and Jane - from greedy New York City businessmen who want to destroy his home for profit in this animated family adventure.

title: Tainted Blood
description: A disturbed drug addicted killer, Stephen, is forced to produce snuff films for an underworld crime organization to repay a long standing debt. As the mutilated bodies start to pile up around him, his savage crimes increase in their intensity. Stephen becomes paranoid that the organization is out to destroy him. He realizes he must make a stand and in an ultra violent finale.

title: Surrender: Hell!
description: The true-life WWII drama about Col. Blackburn who avoided capture by the Japanese in the Philippines by venturing far into the unforgiving jungle, battling disease, starvation, and hostile fire at every turn. He finally amassed a platoon of natives (including headhunters) to his cause, and lead successful attacks on the enemy.

title: Spare Room
cast: Skyler Samuels, Martin Sensmeier, Thomas Cocquerel, Stefanie Scott, Genevieve Angelson, Andrew Burnap, Alicia Witt, Gregory Cruz
description: When a mysterious veteran plagued by flashbacks and guilt after a tour in Afghanistan rents a room from a struggling young waitress caring for her 15 year old brother with Down Syndrome, their attraction sparks unforeseen consequence.

title: Song of Youth
cast: Bai Lu, Wang Yi Zhe, Gina Jin Xu, Jackie Li, He Lei, Zhang Zheng Yang
description: During the Ming dynasty, under Long Qing's rule, Lin Shao Chun's family was destroyed when her father faced accusations of corruption. While attending a performance of the acting troupe Shao Chun has joined, Sun Yun Lou, a wealthy young master, quickly falls for her. With Yun Lou's help, Shao Chun disguises herself as male, allowing her to take the national entrance exams.

title: Sometimes Our Friends Come Over (and sometimes we're all alone)
cast: Stephen Tyler Howell, Allison Blaize
description: A Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf for Trump's America of sorts, Sometimes Our Friends Come Over... is the story of a couple realizing that the future of their relationship and the future of the world will be worse than the present.

title: Some Freaks
cast: Lily Mae Harrington, Thomas Mann
description: Two college seniors, Matt and Jill, fall in love than ever thought possible. However, when graduation comes and Jill moves cross-country to go to college and undergoes a major physical transformation - much to Matt's surprise when he arrives to visit her. While Matt struggles to accept Jill's new look, Jill begins questioning whether Matt is really the man she thought she knew.

title: Sleep Eaters
description: Rachel Stephens tries to uncover the truth behind the unspeakable "Cannibal" Kelly Anderson murders that happened in her town. Meanwhile, Kelly Anderson is now on the run from the law. When their blood-soaked paths cross, we uncover a world filled with more terror, more gore, and a diabolical doctor who has a "cure" and plenty of patients to experiment on.

title: Shark Huntress
cast: Dean Alexandrou, Russell Geoffrey Banks, Katrina Grey, John Buster Flano, Eve Cerda, Gorden Lewis Rimmer, Zarish Ali, Ting Sue, Bonnie Zellerbach, Randy Kalsi
description: A woman takes up her environmentalist mother's David-and-Goliath battle after a lethal shark attack. As she ventures into remote areas-trailed by a blood-thirsty Great White-stakes rise, the death toll mounts ... and she's out for revenge!

title: Road To The Lemon Grove
description: Road to the Lemon Grove is a heartwarming story about a deceased Sicilian father trying to negotiate his way into heaven. But the only way in is to first go back and repair his relationship with his reluctant son, reunite his feuding family back in Sicily, and help all find love in places they never imagined.

title: Red Sun Rising
cast: Don Wilson, Terry Farrell, Mako
description: Thomas Hoshino (Willson) is a tough Japanese detective, who lost his partner by a deadly Yakuza killer Jaho (Lew). He tracks down the killer and his master to Los Angeles, where he teams up with Det. Karen Ryder (Farrell). Soon they discover that Yakuza prepares a gang war and weapon smuggling. Hoshino must find a way to defeat the killer who posses mystical ninja powers.

title: Price Of Love
cast: Icewear Vezzo, Neisha Neshae, K Deezy, Emory Lawrence, Mena Monroe, King Wesley
description: A Brother and Sister facing troubling times coming up in the hardcore streets of Detroit, MI. When one chooses a life of corruption the other choses their career, when faced with a difficult decision they both pay the ultimate Price Of Love.

title: Picasso
cast: Prasad Oak, Ashwini Mukadam, Samay Tambe, Nilkanth Sawant, Vitthal Gaonkar
description: A young student, Gandharva, from a remote village in the Konkan belt of Maharashtra, is selected for the national level of the Picasso Arts Scholarship. The winner of the competition gets to travel to Spain - Picasso's birthplace - to hone their art. Gandharva informs his parents about his selection & also a fee that needs to be paid. But his parents tell him that they cannot afford it.

title: Padmavyuha
cast: Laksh, Digangana Suryavanshi, Noel Sean, Ravi Prakash, Ravi Varma, Kireeti
description: Aravind (Laksh) and Disha (Digangana) are a happy couple enjoying their married life. Suddenly, to Aravind's shock, Disha goes missing. A few clues lead him and the cops in different directions and further confusion. Aravind believes someone well known to Disha is behind this, but having only a little knowledge about Disha's past, would he be able to trace the kidnapper?

title: Open Marriage
cast: Tilky Jones, Nikki Leigh, Kelly Dowdle, Jason Tobias, Debra Wilson
description: Becca and Ron's marriage is in a rut. To rekindle their passion, they agree to experiment in an open relationship with the neighbors. All goes to plan until a stranger creates a dangerous path to betrayal, heartbreak and bloodshed.

title: Obsession
cast: Mekhi Phifer, Elika Portnoy, Brad Dourif, Ruben Santiago-Hudson, Kerry Cahill
description: An entrepreneur hires Sonny (Mekhi Phifer) to work as his mechanic but soon Sonny begins an affair with his employer's alluring wife. The illicit couple concoct a perfect murder but how far are they willing to go to cover their misdeed?

title: Night Feeder
description: Rising fear chokes the free-wheeling underbelly of San Francisco's Music/Art/Drug/Punk scene as a killer stalks the night to feed an unspeakable appetite. Investigation becomes obsession for journalist Jean Michaelson when she probes the gruesome murders with Inspector Alonso Bernardo. Her story hits close to home as the quickening web of death devours neighbors, friends and lovers.

title: Nicholas Nickleby
cast: Charlie Hunnam, Christopher Plummer, Anne Hathaway, Romola Garai, Jim Broadbent, Henry McGrath, Hugh Mitchell, Poppy Rogers, Jessie Lou Roberts
description: After Nicholas' father dies and leaves the family penniless, the Nickleby family moves to London to stay with their Uncle Ralph. Ralph turns abusive and separates the family, which includes sending Nicholas to the cruel and wicked Wackford Squeers. At this horrible escape from the school and set off to reunite the Nickleby family.

title: Mystery of the Nile
description: In 2004, a team of scientists guided by geologist Pasquale Scaturro and kayaker Gordon Brown set out on a voyage to be the first people to traverse the entirety of Africa's Nile River. The expedition takes the group past historic ruins at the heart of Ancient Egyptian Civilization, but this terrific journey also comes with countless dangers from one of the most famous rivers in history.

title: Moonwalkers
cast: Rupert Grint, Ron Perlman, Robert Sheehan
description: After failing to locate the legendary Stanley Kubrick, an unstable CIA agent must instead team up with a seedy rock band manager to develop the biggest con of all time-staging the moon landing.

title: Luxor
cast: Andrea Riseborough, Karim Saleh, Michael Landes, Shirin Redha, Shahira Fahmy, Salima Ikram
description: When British aid worker Hana returns to the ancient city of Luxor, she comes across Sultan, an archeologist and former lover. As she wanders, haunted by the familiar place, she struggles to reconcile the choices of the past with the uncertainty of the present.

title: Kanabadutaledu
cast: Sunil, Vaishali Raj, Sukranth Veerella, Yugram, Himaja
description: Surya(Sukranth) and Vaishali(Sasitha) loves each other but the Vaishali family oppose it. Vaishali planned to elope with Surya, but Surya didn't turn up, after that she was forced to marry Adithya (Yug Ram). When she inquired about Surya no one knows what happened to him then She approached a detective RamaKrishna (Sunil). With many twists and turns how the detective solved this case is the story.

title: Judas
cast: Stan Nze Tamara EteimoLinda Osifo
description: Charles and Victoria are veteran lobbyists who work for one of the biggest firms in the country, Gordon Inc, managed by the ruthless Gideon. They get wind that a multi-million-naira contract is up for grabs and they decide to lobby for it.

title: Joy & Hope
cast: Vivica A. Fox, Cody Calafiore, Ashley Brinkman, Alix Kermes
description: Joy and Hope McGregor run Two Sisters Ranch upstate New York with their dad and longtime friend. When a handsome stranger comes to town to find inspiration to get over writer's block, he learns how special Christmas on the ranch really is.

title: Ivanhoe
cast: Stephen Waddington, Christopher Lee, Siân Phillips, Ronald Pickup
description: Sir Walter Scott's swashbuckling tale of chivalry, romance and bravehearts in medieval England, when Saxons hated their Norman conquerors. The plot is full of heroes and knaves, knightly tournaments and bloody battles. Wilfred of Ivanhoe is estranged from his family and torn between his feelings for a beautiful Jewess and a Saxon heiress.

title: Infinity Paranormal Investigate.
cast: Alan Toop, Vicky D, Mikey D, Kym Toop
description: Investigators of the night. Tune in with us as we investigate haunted locations throughout the UK. With over 30 years experience we hope to provide you with an informative yet raw as it happens series of paranormal investigations from the comfort of your own home.

title: Ide Antaranga Shuddhi
cast: Aryavardhan, Prathibha, Shweta Khelge, Shridhar, Suraj
description: Four unconnected journeys of different characters that includes journey of love, crime, lust and patriotism. Various characters are part of these journeys without any clue of how and where it would end.

title: Honor Among Thieves
cast: Elizabeth Tabish, Thom Hallum, Jordan Walker Ross, Robert Keith, Tom Zembrod, Andy Arrasmith
description: After being injured at war, a civil war veteran returns home to Texas to find he's now enlisted in a new battle, one for his life.

title: Gerri Curls
cast: Mike Grogan, KK Brunson, Renata Bresciani, Stefan Rollins, Danielle Lima, Chellie Garci, Rico Santana, Will Young Sr., Anna Lepeley, Mark Sherwin
description: Gordon (Mike Grogan) joins forces with an unlikely ally (KK Brunson) to fight his half-sister (Renata Bresciani) for the family inheritance and his rightful place among South Florida's curling elite.

title: Filth
cast: James McAvoy, Imogen Poots, Jamie Bell
description: While working on a murder case, a scheming, manipulative policeman starts coming unhinged, slowly losing his grip on reality and suffering from a series of increasingly severe hallucinations as he desperately tries to hold his life together.

title: Faith In Humanity Restored
description: A short documentary exploring the decline in numbers of people being interested in religion and/or attending church.

title: EurOpen People
cast: Marvanza, Alberto Gatto, Giuseppe Cremona, Massimo Ragona
description: Our film project is called EurOpen People, i.e. the face of the positive European related with the environment he lives in.

title: Eric Clapton: Standing at the Crossroads
cast: Eric Clapton, Jack Bruce, Keith Richards
description: Eric Clapton is one of the most influential guitarists of all time. He ranked 2nd in Rolling Stone magazines list of the "100 Greatest Guitarists of All Time" and 4th in Gibson's "Top 50 Guitarists of All Time". In this documentary feature he is interviewed in depth with contributions from Keith Richards, John Mayall, The Yardbirds, Jack Bruce and many more. It is the definitive Clapton biography.

title: Driven to Dance
cast: Kaitlyn Black, Juliet Doherty, Michelle Allen, Asher Angel, Jack Beckham
description: Torn between her mother’s expectations and her own dreams, a ballet dancer must prove she has what it takes to make it big.

title: Die Hard 2 (4K UHD)
cast: Bruce Willis, Bonnie Bedelia, William Atherton, Reginald Veljohnson, Franco Nero, William Sadler, John Amos
description: John McClane is forced to battle mercenaries who seize control of an airport's communications and threaten to cause plane crashes if their demands are not met.

title: Dangerous Afternoon
cast: Nora Nicholson, Ruth Dunning
description: A boarding house run by a former criminal who's made amends since she's become paralyzed is home to a group of older women - all whom also have criminal pasts. Word soon arrives that a former associate of the housemistress is looking for her - with plans of blackmail.

title: Cover-Up
cast: Dolph Lundgren, Louis Gossett Jr., Lisa Berkley
description: A tough ex-U.S. Marine journalist battles against time to save the lives of thousands of innocent people after uncovering a complex terrorist plot.

title: Constantine And The Cross
cast: Cornel Wilde, Belinda Lee, Massimo Serato
description: The might of the sword and the sign of the cross unite in the most thrilling story of faith every told on the screen!

title: CoComelon Halloween Songs
description: It's Halloween season! Join JJ, his family and friends on a CoComelon Halloween journey. Costumes! Candy! And of course some friendly spooky scares. Sing along with CoComelon to all the Halloween fun for kids!

title: Cheyenne Wildcat
cast: Bill Elliott, Robert Blake
description: Red Ryder and Little Beaver solve a case involving a murdered banker and bank fraud in a small Western town. Starring "Wild Bill" Elliott, Robert Blake, and Alice Fleming.

title: CBGB
cast: Alan Rickman, Malin Akerman, Justin Bartha, Johnny Galecki, Kyle Gallner, Ashley Greene, Rupert Grint, Bradley Whitford, Joel David Moore, Taylor Hawkins
description: Alan Rickman stars as legendary NYC club owner Hilly Kristal, who during the 1970s, wanted to create a venue for country, bluegrass and blues music (thus the name CBGB). When those acts became difficult to book, he shifted the club's focus to local bands playing original music, launching the careers of Patti Smith, Blondie, the Talking Heads and the Ramones and helping to define the punk scene.

title: Brahmanandam Drama Company
cast: Kamalinee Mukherjee, Sivaji, Ravi Krishna, Samiksha, Brahmanandam
description: When Anandam's drama company gets a chance to perform in Bangkok, three actors run into several hilarious situations as they try to bag the lead role.

title: Black Book
cast: Carice van Houten, Sebastian Koch, Thom Hoffman, Michiel Huisman, Matthias Schoenaerts, Christian Berkel
description: In the Nazi-occupied Netherlands during World War II, a Jewish singer infiltrates the regional Gestapo headquarters for the Dutch resistance.

title: All Good Things
cast: Ryan Gosling, Kirsten Dunst, Frank Langella, Philip Baker Hall
description: HD. Ryan Gosling stars as the heir to a real estate dynasty who is suspected of murdering his wife in this chilling psychological thriller.

title: A Spark in Nothing
cast: Benjamin Snow, Brianna Ripkowski, Abby Stevens, Eric Mickelson, Sam Grossinger, Blake Borders, Corrinne Mica, Ernest Keith Walker, Arielle Gottesman
description: With one single choice, everything changes. One life splits into two realities. One chasing a chance at love, while the other finds solace in music.

title: A Monkey's Tale
cast: Wendy Wolfcarius, John Hurt, Rik Mayall, Michael York, Michael Gambon, Sally Ann Marsh, Matt Hill, Shirley Anne Field, Diana Quick, French Tickner, William Vanderpuye, Paul Dobson, Michael Dobson, Peter Elliott, Janyse Jaud, Alix Bates, Chris Connor, Anthony Jackson, Alexander John, Chantal Keast, Miles Laddie, Chris Lang
description: Two monkey tribes are divided by centuries of fear and prejudice. When curious teenager Kom plummets from his home, his family consider him lost forever. Below, however, his life is spared, and he soon becomes the King's favourite - which angers the Chancellor, who plans seize power for himself. Kom and loyal maid, Gina, uncover the plot, plan to reunite the two tribes and save the day.

title: 50 Summers
cast: Rob Riggle
description: Follow the evolution of Minor League Baseball over the last half century through the ups and downs of the Omaha franchise as they kick-off their historic 50th season as the affiliate of the KC Royals -the longest in Triple A baseball.

title: What Lies Beneath
cast: Monic Hendrickx, Fedja van Huêt, Daan Schuurmans, Susan Visser
description: After many years abroad, a woman's homecoming becomes a nightmare as she's the target of violent attacks. To stop them, she must dig deep into the darkness of her family's past.

title: Warning From Space
cast: Keizô Kawasaki, Toyomi Karita, Bin Yagisawa
description: As Japan is rocked by mysterious sightings of UFOs over Tokyo and large one-eyed aliens attempting contact, scientists collaborate to investigate the unexpected rise in extraterrestrial activity. Unbeknownst to them, one of the aliens has already assumed human form and is about to deliver a very important message... that could be humanity's last hope for survival.

title: Wallflower
cast: David Call, Atsuko Okatsuka, Conner Marx
description: Based on the shocking untold American tragedy, a troubled loner is befriended by an eccentric group of ravers and finds himself conflicted about his intentions.

title: True Horror
cast: Kellie Shirley, Amy Morgan, James Tarpey, Adam Leese
description: Drawing on the testimonies from people at the centre of each story and other witnesses, this docudrama presents true encounters with the paranormal.

title: Trapped Child
cast: Katrina Bowden, Krew Hodges, Nixon Hodges
description: A mother and her son plan a surprise visit to Los Angeles to see her husband/his father. Halfway there they get into a terrible accident in the middle of nowhere and now must fight to survive.

title: Too Too Boy
cast: Vishal TM, Rangarao
description: Too Too Boy is all set to laugh and learn! He's full of wild ideas, but trouble seems to find him at every corner. Everything and anything amazes him as he explores the world around him with wonder and excitement.

title: The Whistle Blower
cast: Michael Caine, James Fox, Nigel Havers, Sir John Gielgud, Felicity Dean
description: In this gripping espionage thriller, English patriot & army vet Frank Jones (Michael Caine) is only mildly concerned when his son Bob, who works for the British Secret Service, says dirty dealings are afoot at the agency. But when Bob is murdered under mysterious circumstances, Frank's inquiries thrust him into the middle of a rat's nest of government deceit that could cost Frank his own life!

title: The Undertaker
cast: Joe Spinell, Rebeca Yaron, Susan Bachli, Charles Kay-Hune, Joe Magle
description: A deranged undertaker kills various people to keep as his friends in his seedy funeral home.

title: The People of the Kattawapiskak River
description: The people of the Attawapiskat First Nation were thrust into the national spotlight in 2012 when the impoverished living conditions on their reserve became an issue of national debate. With The People of the Kattawapiskak River, Abenaki director Alanis Obomsawin quietly attends as community members tell their own story, shedding light on a history of dispossession and official indifference.

title: The Host (English Subtitled)
cast: Kang-ho Song, Hie-bong Byeon, Hae-il Park, Du-na Bae, Ah-sung Ko, David Joseph Anselmo, Martin E. Cayce, Cristen Cho, Philip Hersh, Paul Lazar, Brian Lee, Kurt Leitner, Clinton Morgan, Dal-su Oh, No-shik Park, Brian Rhee, Scott Wilson, Pil-Sung Yim
description: On 09 February 2000, the American military base of Yongson releases toxic chemicals in the drain to the Han River under the direct order of an arrogant coroner. Six years later, a mutant squid monster emerges from Seoul's Han River and focuses its attention on attacking people.

title: The Green Sea
cast: Katharine Isabelle, Hazel Doupe, Dermot Ward, Amy Joyce Hastings, Ciaron Davies
description: A troubled musician lives in self-imposed isolation until a chance meeting lures her into a potent mystery, tied to the unexpected appearance of a wayward teen girl and an enigmatic stalker who lurks in the shadows of her every move.

title: The Consequence
cast: Wanly Florexile, Saul Joseph, Geraldine Lalanne, Sean DeRose, Siliek Wynder
description: Dave a struggling farmer from a poverty town of Haiti suddenly becoming a single father believes his wife death was the reason of a voodoo priest. Giving an opportunity to escape into the US, but however from the moment arrived trouble seemed to follow. this picture depict an immigrant man faced with no options is a dangerous one.

title: The Best of Videogyan
cast: Vishal TM, Rangarao
description: From singing gorillas to classic nursery rhymes and fairy tales, the best of Videogyan is a collection of animated stories and sing alongs for young children.

title: Piper's Pony Tales
description: When Piper makes up stories about her toy ponies, they magically come to life through the power of her imagination, transporting her and her friends into amazing adventures!

title: Pinkfong! Let's Booksplore with Hogi: Space
description: Welcome to the mysterious library where books fly around! Follow Hogi in this adventure. Which book will Hogi open next?

title: Parched 2: Hangry
cast: Remiara Eve, Angelica Adams, Caroline Plyler, Marie Jose Peltier, Elliot Wygoda, Alexander Pineiro, Asel Otunchieva, Justen Chu, Anthony Notarile, Steve Machita
description: A social media influencer brings her friends to an Airbnb lake house to party. When an appetite stimulant is mistakenly dumped into the lake and the guests go for a dip, they emerge ravenous and insatiable.

title: Open Five 2
cast: Kentucker Audley, Brook Bloom, Sophia Takal, Kate Lyn Sheil, Dustin Guy Defa
description: A relationship drama set amid a winter van trip from New York to New Orleans. A loose continuation of the 2010 film Open 5.

title: One
cast: Mammootty, Murali Gopy
description: A righteous politician's unflinching loyalty to his ideologies is sorely tested after some damning allegations are levelled against him.

title: Nick Baker's Weird Creatures
cast: Nick Baker
description: Nick Baker searches for some of nature's Weird Creatures - from the master of disguise the mimic octopus to the tiny primate who's eyes are literary bigger than it's belly. Some would dismiss these oddities as freaks of nature, but for Nick, these are the unsung heroes of evolutionary biology.

title: My Ancestors Were Rogues and Murderers
description: Revisiting the PR coup that launched the animal rights movement onto the international stage: the 1977 Newfoundland visit, orchestrated by the International Fund for Animal Welfare, of actress turned activist Brigitte Bardot to protest the area's ancestral sealing activities. Soon, inhabitants of the island's northern outports we're being introduced to the world as the epitome of brutality.

title: Messalina
cast: Belinda Lee, Spyros Fokas, Carlo Giustini
description: Scheming Messalina marries Roman Emperor Claudius but goes too far with a gladiator.

title: Magari resto (Maybe I'll stay)
cast: Caterina Misasi, Enrico Lo Verso, Pietro De Silva, Veronica Maya, Emiliano De Martino, Rosaria De Cicco, Lucio Bastolla, Felice Avella, Pier Luigi Misasi, Sebastiano Gavasso, Valentina Corti, Noemi Giangrande, Andrea Napoleoni, Antonio Braucci
description: Francesca is getting ready for her wedding, when she realizes that something in her life doesn't work. She starts asking herself important questions and looking for answers, even in faith, thanks to the help of Don Fabio. At the end she stumbles upon the truth that will become the only useful element for making her choice.

title: Made in Chinatown
cast: Tony Darrow, Vincent Pastore, Raymond J. Barry, Lo Meng, Jay Kwon, James Lew, Shuya Chang
description: It's Goodfellas meets Ip Man when a young Chinese nobody sets out to become a Don in the Italian Mafia. But tensions are high between the two cultures already as they move into each other's turf and a dirty crime commissioner is playing both sides. It turns out that earning respect, finding love, and discovering his identity doesn't come so easy. He'll have to fight his way to the top.

title: Lured Innocence
cast: Dennis Hopper, Marley Shelton, Devon Gummersall, Talia Shire, Michael Cudlitz
description: Elsie Townsend is a country towns-girl who wants to leave far away and get rich. She becomes the spoiled mistress of married local businessman Rick Chambers, but when his sickly wife Martha tells her to fear he wants to kill her to be free and yet keep her money, accepts to kill him together- which is a setup to scare Martha to dead.

title: Legend of a Warrior
cast: Frank Lee, Corey Lee
description: In this feature length documentary, filmmaker Corey Lee attempts to reconnect with his father, renowned martial artist Frank Lee. Frank's status as legendary street fighter and coach have kept him at an emotional (and physical) distance from his son, but now the younger Lee has decided to re-enter his father's world... a world where fighting rules.

title: Lance Woods: Undeniable
cast: Lance Woods
listed_in: Arts, Entertainment, and Culture, Comedy, Special Interest
description: In his first comedy special, Lance Woods shares his unique take on race relations, slave movies, dating and plenty of yeah-he-just-went-there moments. Undeniable showcases Lance's distinctive ability to be an equal opportunity offender.

title: La Cambiale
cast: Vittorio Gassman, Totò, Ugo Tognazzi
description: An industrialist, who is considered rich and instead ends up in prison for insolvency, releases to two lestofanti a bill of exchange for one hundred thousand lire. The two turn it over to the owner of a tobacco shop, who in turn gives it to the owner of a pet store...

title: Kept Woman
cast: Courtney Ford, Shaun Benson, Andrew W. Walker, Rachel Wilson
description: Jessica and her fiancé finally move out of the city and into their dream home on a quiet suburban street. When their strange and mysterious new neighbor lures Jessica inside his home, she finds herself imprisoned in a meticulously decorated 1950's bunker.

title: Jurassic Galaxy
cast: Madison West, Eric Paul Erickson, Frankie Ray, Doug Bunch, Jonathan Nation, Ryan Budds
description: In the near future, a ship of space explorers crash land on an unknown planet. They're soon met with some of their worst fears as they discover the planet is inhabited by monstrous dinosaurs.

title: Invasion of the Cubecumbers
cast: Sampley Barinaga, Harrison Stone, Brittany J. Smith, Noah Lombard, Avery Patz, JD Thorne, Brannon Hollingsworth
description: When Kip applies too much fertilizer to a crop of cubecumbers, he and his family scramble to put the abundance to good use and learn some critical lessons in the process. Cubekins is a 3D animated Christian kids' show for ages 4-7 that's all about family, faith, and fun! Follow Kip's adventures which show that even though the world may change from moment to moment, our Heavenly Father does not.

title: Iberion
cast: Guillermo Llorca Andreu, Kevin Hidalgo Lopez, Joan Castillo Faraco, Nuria Rodrigo Ortiz, Aitana Moya Vieiro, Javier Marin Ferrandiz, Elena Llorca Andreu
description: Jack is a loser who's in love with a girl who doesn't even know his name. His luck changes after finding the book... When he reads it, good things happen to him, but if a whole day goes by without reading the book, horrible things happen.

title: I Motorizzati
cast: Nino Manfredi, Ugo Tognazzi
description: A guy is about to become the millionth citizen to buy a car in Rome. Frightened, he decides to remain pedestrian, and recalls several stories, with new car owners as protagonists.

title: Hyderabad Dreams
cast: Tarhun, Giri, Roja, Priyanka, Kavya, Lanka Raj
description: Five various people have dreams about their future and entered into Hyderabad but seffers a lot and finally one person helps them to come up of their problems and finally they succeeded to reaches their goal and all lives happy

title: Hatched
cast: Georgie Banks, Megan Purvis, Marshall Hawkes, Thomas Loone, Richard Kovacs
description: An obsessive scientist discovers a way to bring dinosaurs back to life and when his family comes to visit, they find him dead, eaten by his creations. If they escape, these monsters could threaten the city, so they must be contained and destroyed.

title: Gopyam - The Secret
cast: Tarhun, All rounder star Ballem Venu madhav, Annapoorna, Suman Shetty, Raghu, Gundu Hanumanthu rao, Anoosha
description: Bahubali is a child who was sufferd by a bad police man and finally Bahubali kills shekar and rescues from all dangers. Another three girls involve in a murder and bahubali else them to came out of the problem

title: Goodbye Seventies
cast: Chris Rehmann, Ken Kaissar, Andrew Cawley, James Kleinmann, Justin Ivan Brown
description: In the 1970s, the golden age of gay pornography in New York City, a promising chorus boy is injured and told he will never dance again. Distraught and unimpressed with the "art" films playing seedy Times Square theaters, he gets his friends together to make their own hardcore movies. Against all odds the films are successful until drugs, AIDS and cheap video technology bring it all crashing down.

title: Go Buster - Classic Nursery Rhymes & Songs (Made by Little Baby Bum)

title: Harry Brown
cast: Michael Caine, Emily Mortimer, Joseph Gilgun, Sean Harris
description: Harry Brown, starring two-time Academy Award winner Michael Caine, follows one man's journey through a chaotic world where teenage violence runs rampant. As a modest, law abiding citizen, Brown lives alone. His only companion is his best friend Leonard. When Leonard is killed, Brown reaches his breaking point. Harry Brown is a powerful, character driven thriller.
